Messages.Author: Mike Mayer
Messages.Body:
I have some questions I really need answering. We had a big fight last
night when we played and I would like to resolve the issue quickly.

1) Cat's Guidence. The regular version says that you can untap the
vampire right after the vampire successfully blocks. Does this mean:
- The vampire untaps before combat takes place (like a strike
combat ends card).
- After the combat resulting from the block, the vampire untaps.

2) Equiping with guns/equipment. Can you equip with more than one at
a time? (i.e. Can I tap Black Cat to bring out IR Goggles, Bastard Sword,
and a Laptop all at once, or in three seperate actions). The rule book
is vague and could be interpreted either way.

Thanks very much...

Mike

P.S. I'm another Jyhad player (atleast 2 times a week) and I am not
buying any cards that don't have Jyhad on the back. Period.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

Mike Mayer <MR...@psuvm.psu.edu> wrote:
>I have some questions I really need answering. We had a big fight last
>night when we played and I would like to resolve the issue quickly.
>
> 1) Cat's Guidence. The regular version says that you can untap the
>vampire right after the vampire successfully blocks. Does this mean:
> - The vampire untaps before combat takes place (like a strike
> combat ends card).
> - After the combat resulting from the block, the vampire untaps.
>

After the combat: [DTR 2/9/95]
1) When exactly is "immediately after the vampire has blocked", i.e., when is
Cat's Guidance used?

Immediately after combat has ended.

> 2) Equiping with guns/equipment. Can you equip with more than one at
>a time? (i.e. Can I tap Black Cat to bring out IR Goggles, Bastard Sword,
>and a Laptop all at once, or in three seperate actions). The rule book
>is vague and could be interpreted either way.

One peice per action. [12.3.1]:
If the equip action is unblocked, the equipment card is placed on
the minion.

Card is singular.

When transferring equipment between minions, you may take as much
equipment as you want from the same minion in one action.

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:
Mike Mayer <MR...@psuvm.psu.edu> wrote:
> 1) Cat's Guidence. The regular version says that you can untap the
> vampire right after the vampire successfully blocks. Does this mean:
> - The vampire untaps before combat takes place (like a strike
> combat ends card).
> - After the combat resulting from the block, the vampire untaps.

Peace Mike,

First, when in doubt - don't fight. Flip a coin. Play that way. Then
ask here. If the flip went wrong, play the right way _next_ time.

The answer to your first question is a vampire that plays CG untaps AFTER
combat is over (which is when you play the card, not before).

> 2) Equiping with guns/equipment. Can you equip with more than one at
> a time? (i.e. Can I tap Black Cat to bring out IR Goggles, Bastard Sword,
> and a Laptop all at once, or in three seperate actions). The rule book
> is vague and could be interpreted either way.

Each equipment card is a separate action. It would take Black Cat three
actions to equip with all the things in your example.

> P.S. I'm another Jyhad player (atleast 2 times a week) and I am not
> buying any cards that don't have Jyhad on the back. Period.

Hopefully, WotC will get the message [DON'T CHANGE THE CARD BACKS!] and
correct this error.

Nil carborundum illigitimi,
